items.title: Isaiah "Ike" Robinson Interview, 1961-04-28
items.q: He used to call him Brown, uh, Frey.

ctx.x: That's not a head of it.

See, every time he come up with the bucket had a hold of it. Yeah, well I'm telling you, I had to come up the hard way and had some tough reps. Finally, well, uh, started playing with a pretty good band. They called it the Liberty Bell. Liberty Bell.
I've heard of it. I don't remember who was in it, but who else was in it?
